info.title: Siperp API
info.description: Partial API contract. Includes Core foundation and Academy participant registration; other runtime endpoints are defined by their module routes and tests.

bearerAuth.description: Sanctum personal access token; absolute lifetime seven days. No session cookies.

diagnosticCode.description: Stable public diagnostic category such as DB_SCHEMA_MISMATCH, DB_UNAVAILABLE or APP_KEY_MISSING. Does not expose SQL or configuration values.

requestId.description: Server-generated support reference, also returned as X-Request-ID and recorded in api_request_failed logs for server failures.

retryAfter.description: Seconds until retry when the server supplies Retry-After.

phone.description: Indonesian mobile number; local 08 prefix is normalized to 628.

cohortId.description: Existing cohort ID; required for admin creation.

courseId.description: Optional existing course; if cohort-bound it must belong to the chosen cohort.

Indonesian mobile number; local 08 prefix is normalized to 628.

cohortId.description: Optional cohort change, subject to previous cohort completion rules.

courseId.description: Optional existing course; if cohort-bound it must belong to the chosen cohort.

heroImage.description: Image URL returned by the authenticated SARSIP upload endpoint. Null uses the built-in illustration. Omission on update preserves the saved photo for older clients.
Image URL returned by the authenticated SARSIP upload endpoint. Null uses the built-in illustration. Omission on update preserves the saved photo for older clients.

cohortId.description: Existing Academy cohort ID; no program or open registration required.

gender.description: One group for every participant in the workbook.

phone.description: Indonesian mobile number; 08, 8, 628 and +628 prefixes accepted. Spaces, parentheses, dots and hyphens removed; stored as 628 followed by 7–12 digits. Duplicate normalized numbers within one batch rejected.

password.description: Default initial password 12345678 for newly imported participants. Must be changed on first login; persisted only as a password hash. Existing accounts are never reset by re-importing.

code.description: Existing ERP account code; outer whitespace is trimmed and lookup is case-insensitive.

shortLocation.description: District and city without administrative prefixes. Falls back to locality segments from applicant.street, then region. House numbers and the street line are excluded. Empty when unavailable.

BantuanPhotoLocation.description: Uploader-provided coordinates, not verified proof. exif = GPS from original metadata; device = device position at upload, not capture. Encrypted at rest. Legacy photos have null location.

BantuanTelephone.description: Applicant phone and optional reporterPhone on application create/update: 8–15 digits, optional leading + (international code cannot start with 0), spaces/hyphens and balanced numeric area-code parentheses. Letters, extensions and invalid digit counts return 422. Enforced on drafts too when present; reporterPhone remains nullable. Formatting is preserved.

cohortId.description: Required when creating a material; existing scoped material cannot move cohorts.

file.description: Optional replacement audio, maximum 50 MiB. MP3, WAV, OGG or M4A.

pdfFile.description: Optional PDF attachment, maximum 10 MiB. MIME and file header validated. Appends to existing attachments.

tanwirSubmissionMedia.description: files returned in authorized teacher-review and student-task detail. Legacy single-file submissions return one item.

ojolSubmissionMedia.description: files returned in authorized teacher-review and student-task detail. Legacy single-file submissions return one item.

get.summary: Application and database health

post.summary: Login with account code and password
post.description: Issues an HttpOnly Sanctum session cookie. Five attempts per minute per normalized code/IP. Email login is not supported.

pwa.description: Bantuan PWA login. Requires active module access. Issues a persistent 30-day cookie/token exempt from the shorter Sanctum browser age. Explicit logout, account deactivation and token revocation still apply.

200.description: Authenticated; data contains userId, name, code, isSuperadmin, moduleSlugs and moduleRoles. Set-Cookie issues the HttpOnly session.

401.description: Incorrect account code or password, or inactive account

post.summary: Create an Academy participant as an authorized administrator.

201.description: Participant account and profile created atomically.

post.summary: Register in the currently open Academy cohort.
post.description: The server selects the open cohort and ignores caller-provided cohortId and courseId. Returns 409 when registration closes; no program is required.

201.description: Participant account and profile created atomically.

put.summary: Update an Academy participant as an authorized administrator.

post.summary: Tambah santunan rutin atau tidak rutin
post.description: Admin/bendahara. Kategori rutin: widow, orphan, foster_child, tahfidz (Lembaga Tahfidz). Tidak rutin hanya orphan. Penyalur harus aktif dan memiliki akses.

201.description: Santunan dibuat; data memuat id, number, frequency, category, period, recipientName, volunteerId, amount, transferStatus, distributionStatus, transferredAt, completedAt, version, report, documents

get.summary: Read authorized santunan and photo pins
get.description: Existing role scope and filters apply. Volunteers only see assigned records. Private no-store.

get.summary: Own published lesson details and attachments
get.description: Requires enrollment and a published course, chapter and lesson. Unreleased content has no attachments. Released lesson attachments expose only id, lessonId, title, fileUrl and fileType (nullable MIME), never storage paths. PDFs added after enrollment remain visible. File URLs enforce participant permissions separately.

200.description: data contains lesson and own note; lesson.attachments includes MIME fileType for distinguishing PDF from audio

get.summary: Own ranking among enrolled participants
get.description: total counts distinct active enrolled participants, including those without completed exams. Returns one group per enrolled cohort (legacy courses without cohort stay separate). Includes all active nondeleted participants in the same cohort, including unattempted participants. participants contains only rank, name, score, predicate, complete, finalCompleted, durationMs, finishedAt and isSelf. Sort by score descending, durationMs ascending, finishedAt ascending (null last), case-insensitive name alphabetically, then stable internal profile ID if names also coincide. Sequential ranks are unique. Best scoring attempt per exam is chosen, ties by duration then submission time; finishedAt is the latest such submission when all published exams are finished. Missing/unscored exams use full time limits and zero score. Contacts, answer snapshots and other cohorts are not exposed. finalCompleted is true only when all published FINAL exams in that enrollment have a completed scored attempt; absence of FINAL exams remains temporary. participants without completed exams also receive unique ranks. Uncompleted published exams count as zero in the weighted score.

200.description: Own cohort ranking groups with cohortId, courseId, title, rank, total, score, predicate, complete, finalCompleted, durationMs, finishedAt and ordered participants

get.summary: Own learning and certificate progress
get.description: Enrollment overview includes totalQuizzes, completedQuizzes (distinct completed exams with non-null scores), legacy passedQuizzes, lesson counters and grading. certificateVisible and isEligible require a published course, at least one published FINAL exam, and all published exams having a closesAt deadline that has elapsed. Eligibility applies to every enrolled participant, including those with no completed exams. Missing deadlines keep certificates hidden. completedAt is the latest exam deadline.

200.description: Own enrollment overview; completedQuizzes is a nonnegative integer

post.summary: Start or resume own exam
post.description: Server grades using snapshotted kind DAILY/WEEKLY/FINAL. Correct answers receive full question weight; incorrect nonempty valid selections receive half weight for DAILY/WEEKLY and zero for FINAL. Blank answers receive zero. MULTIPLE requires the exact set for full credit. Existing completed attempts are not recalculated. Legacy unfinished snapshots without kind use current exam kind. Answer keys remain hidden for unfinished attempts; the owner can review them immediately after completion.

201.description: Attempt started or answers saved; grading is server-controlled

put.summary: Save own answers or submit exam
put.description: Server grades using snapshotted kind DAILY/WEEKLY/FINAL. Correct answers receive full question weight; incorrect nonempty valid selections receive half weight for DAILY/WEEKLY and zero for FINAL. Blank answers receive zero. MULTIPLE requires the exact set for full credit. Existing completed attempts are not recalculated. Legacy unfinished snapshots without kind use current exam kind. Answer keys remain hidden for unfinished attempts; the owner can review them immediately after completion.

200.description: Attempt started or answers saved; grading is server-controlled

get.summary: Read own exam attempt
get.description: Server grades using snapshotted kind DAILY/WEEKLY/FINAL. Correct answers receive full question weight; incorrect nonempty valid selections receive half weight for DAILY/WEEKLY and zero for FINAL. Blank answers receive zero. MULTIPLE requires the exact set for full credit. Existing completed attempts are not recalculated. Legacy unfinished snapshots without kind use current exam kind. Answer keys remain hidden for unfinished attempts; the owner can review them immediately after completion.

200.description: Own attempt; answers snapshot includes optional kind enum DAILY/WEEKLY/FINAL, questions and responses. Correct-answer fields and explanations are omitted while the attempt is unfinished.

post.summary: Impor santunan rutin dari Excel yang telah dibaca klien
post.description: Admin/bendahara, maksimal 200 baris; atomik. Nama/program/periode yang sama ditolak, termasuk impor ulang. Nama verifikator per baris dicocokkan ke satu penyalur aktif. verifierName wajib bila volunteerId legacy tidak dikirim; jika keduanya ada, nama per baris berlaku. Nama ambigu/tidak dikenal ditolak atomik. Status awal pending/process. Dibatasi 10/menit; no-store, private.

verifierName.description: Nama persis dari daftar penyalur aktif; abaikan kapital dan spasi berlebih. Nama ambigu/tidak aktif/tidak ada ditolak. Wajib bila volunteerId legacy tidak dikirim.

422.description: Data invalid, penerima ganda, atau penyalur tidak aktif; tidak ada baris disimpan

delete.summary: Delete a test donation or zakat ledger record (LAZSIP admin or Superadmin)
delete.description: Requires confirmationCode matching tracking code (legacy: ID), and accepted testTransaction acknowledgement, including Production tests. Does not call iPaymu or refund. Blocks active session creation/email delivery and Core-reconciled payments. Removes receipts and orphan zakat details, preserves donor/campaign and idempotency tombstones, and logs administrator deletion without donor PII. Limited to 10/minute.

422.description: Missing acknowledgement or mismatching confirmation code

get.summary: Export complete Bantuan report for module admin, Superadmin and Call Center
get.description: Uses application listing filters and access scope. Other operational roles are forbidden, including Monitoring. Records an export audit event and returns Cache-Control: no-store, private. Limited to 5 requests per minute.

200.description: Private report rows for XLSX generation, without pagination.

403.description: Requires module admin, Superadmin or Call Center role

post.summary: Save teacher material with optional audio upload
post.description: Academy teacher/admin only. Audio and publication saved atomically. New materials append automatically within the chapter; edits preserve order. Teacher materials use releaseDay 1 (available once the course has started). Manual order/releaseDay inputs are ignored. Omitted audio preserves existing source. Maximum 50 MB. Supports MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A and browser WebM recordings.

get.summary: List teacher materials with cohort filter and server pagination
get.description: Teacher/admin only. view=table returns items, chapters (selector metadata only), cohorts, page, lastPage, total and perPage=10. Without view=table the legacy chapter response is preserved. Stable ascending creation time and ID ordering. Excess pages clamp to the last page.

post.summary: Save teacher material with optional audio upload
post.description: Academy teacher/admin only. Audio and publication saved atomically. New materials append automatically within the chapter; edits preserve order. Teacher materials use releaseDay 1 (available once the course has started). Manual order/releaseDay inputs are ignored. Omitted audio preserves existing source. Maximum 50 MB. Supports MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A and browser WebM recordings.

get.summary: List teacher exams with cohort filtering and pagination
get.description: Teacher/admin only. view=table returns items (exam identity, cohort/chapter, type, start/close timestamps, duration, question count and status), chapters selector metadata, cohorts, page, lastPage, total, perPage=10. Legacy chapter response remains without view=table.

post.summary: Save teacher exam with daily chapter or weekly/final cohort curriculum
post.description: Teacher/admin only. DAILY requires chapterId. WEEKLY/FINAL creation accepts courseId from the selected cohort curriculum without chapterId; existing clients may still send chapterId. Edits preserve existing curriculum relationship. Mismatched chapter/course rejected 422. Existing quiz validation and publication requirements apply.

get.summary: Read teacher exam editor and paginated questions
get.description: Teacher/admin only: question options and keys are private. view=table limits quiz.questions to 10/page and adds cohortTitle and pagination (page,lastPage,total,perPage). Other quiz fields and scope are unchanged. Legacy request returns all questions.

200.description: Exam editor with question options and teacher-only keys

post.summary: Save teacher exam with daily chapter or weekly/final cohort curriculum
post.description: Teacher/admin only. DAILY requires chapterId. WEEKLY/FINAL creation accepts courseId from the selected cohort curriculum without chapterId; existing clients may still send chapterId. Edits preserve existing curriculum relationship. Mismatched chapter/course rejected 422. Existing quiz validation and publication requirements apply.

get.summary: Stream private image or audio attached to an Academy question
get.description: Academy authentication is required. Teacher/admin roles may read question media; participants must be enrolled and authorized for the related quiz. Files are stored outside the public web root and responses disable caching and MIME sniffing.

get.summary: List published materials within the viewer cohort access
get.description: sort=latest orders by creation time descending then ID; default keeps curriculum ordering. Existing publication, membership and module checks remain. Returns items, total, page, pages.

get.summary: List teacher discussions with pagination
get.description: Teacher/admin only. Detail includes question, answer, dates, participant name and cohort/program metadata. List view=table returns items,page,pages,total at 10 per page, unanswered first. Legacy list response remains without view=table.

get.summary: Read private teacher discussion detail
get.description: Teacher/admin only. Detail includes question, answer, dates, participant name and cohort/program metadata. List view=table returns items,page,pages,total at 10 per page, unanswered first. Legacy list response remains without view=table.

get.summary: List own participant discussions
get.description: Active participant profile required. Only own discussions in enrolled published courses are returned; foreign detail IDs return 404. view=table returns questions as items,page,pages,total at 10 per page alongside existing enrollments/session metadata. Legacy list response preserved otherwise.

get.summary: Read own participant discussion
get.description: Active participant profile required. Only own discussions in enrolled published courses are returned; foreign detail IDs return 404. view=table returns questions as items,page,pages,total at 10 per page alongside existing enrollments/session metadata. Legacy list response preserved otherwise.

get.summary: List live Q&A sessions and cohort curriculum choices for teachers
get.description: Teacher/admin only. Returns courses selector metadata and sessions (items,page,pages,total), 10/page, latest start first. Meeting links remain private to managers and enrolled participants through the existing participant discussions endpoint.

post.summary: Create a live Q&A meeting schedule
post.description: Teacher/admin only. startsAt is explicit WIB (UTC+7), stored in UTC, and must be in the future. Meeting URL is supplied by the teacher; no room is created by this endpoint.

post.summary: Prepare at least 12 chapters and a 30-day cohort curriculum
post.description: Academy admin only. Idempotent; preserves existing chapters, lessons and progress. New cohorts are prepared automatically.

post.summary: Import participant registrations from parsed Excel rows
post.description: Explicit bulk-registration action returning 200. Active Academy admin/superadmin only. The browser reads one .xlsx worksheet (up to 5 MiB) with Nama, No HP, Alamat headers; only parsed rows are sent to Laravel. Atomic transaction: any invalid/conflicting row rolls back the batch. Exact existing active participants (same normalized phone, case-insensitive name, trimmed address, cohort membership and group) are skipped; passwords and memberships remain unchanged. Other matches are rejected with row-specific 422 details; old accounts are never moved to another cohort. New accounts receive PAZ login codes, mandatory password change and cohort/program enrollment. Response has Cache-Control: no-store, private; no stored import file or plaintext-password history. Re-imports never return old passwords.

200.description: Atomic import result; download credentials before leaving the page.

get.summary: Read public SARSIP profile and hero image

put.summary: Save SARSIP profile and optional hero image
put.description: Requires an active user with SARSIP access. Older clients may omit heroImage to keep the current photo; send null to return to the built-in illustration.

post.summary: Log in to Bantuan mobile using an existing ERP account
post.description: Core credentials and live Bantuan module access are checked before issuing a bantuan-mobile Sanctum token. Expiration follows Core TokenIssuer. No session cookie is created or changed. Use the token as Bearer authorization on the existing Bantuan notifications endpoint. Uses the shared throttle:login limiter (5 attempts per minute per normalized account code and IP).

post.summary: Register or rotate the current mobile sessions FCM device
post.description: Requires bantuan-mobile Sanctum token, active user and live Bantuan access. Device token is encrypted at rest. Upsert is idempotent; no token is returned.

delete.summary: Unregister devices belonging to the current mobile session
Revoke the current mobile session and remove its devices
delete.description: Requires a bantuan-mobile Sanctum token. Logout remains available after module access is revoked.

post.summary: Buat santunan rutin bulan berikutnya
post.description: Admin/bendahara saja. Seluruh rutin bulan sumber disalin secara atomik; tidak rutin, laporan dan foto tidak disalin. Tujuan yang sudah memiliki rutin ditolak.

422.description: Input invalid, sumber kosong, atau penyalur tidak aktif

get.summary: Read public Firebase Web config and current PWA session binding
get.description: Requires next-server session, active user and Bantuan access. No Sanctum token, service-account key or server file path is returned. Cookie callers use the normal Core session.

post.summary: Register or rotate the current web sessions PWA FCM device
post.description: Requires active next-server session, Bantuan access and configured Firebase Web/VAPID. Token encrypted at rest; one registration per web session. Repeat preserves registration start date; a shared browser token changes owner atomically.

delete.summary: Unregister the current web sessions PWA device
delete.description: Remains available after Bantuan access is revoked. Other sessions and native registrations remain untouched.

post.summary: Upload private santunan evidence
post.description: Assigned volunteer or module admin; only after transfer and before completion. transfer_receipt is optional and never replaces aid_paper or recipient_photo. One file per kind; encrypted storage.

file.description: JPEG, PNG or WEBP; maximum 2048 KiB

location.description: Uploader-provided coordinates, not verified proof. exif = GPS from original metadata; device = device position at upload, not capture. Encrypted at rest. Legacy photos have null location.

post.summary: Submit an assigned survey
post.description: Requires the assigned verifier (or module admin). Completeness and evidence checks remain mandatory. All survey submissions enter survey_cc_review. Call Center officers may review their own assigned surveys and explicitly forward them with survey_review_submit to survey_submitted for independent Approver review. Self approval remains forbidden.

200.description: Survey recorded with current application status and version

get.summary: Participant activity and quiz performance report
get.description: Admin/superadmin see their module. Guru Tanwir sees current PIC groups and relevant tasks; Ojol guru sees only tasks they own or co-review. Participants denied. Denominator uses current group and task creation dates in WIB; results are current, not historical enrollment snapshots. Missing = assigned minus submitted; overdue = expired minus submitted expired tasks. Consistent = at least 80% assigned tasks submitted on time. Score is average quiz score; summary is weighted by quiz count. Private no-store. Pagination applies to participants; export follows all pages.

200.description: Paginated participant metrics with filtered summary and authorized filter options

get.summary: Participant activity and quiz performance report
get.description: Admin/superadmin see their module. Guru Tanwir sees current PIC groups and relevant tasks; Ojol guru sees only tasks they own or co-review. Participants denied. Denominator uses current group and task creation dates in WIB; results are current, not historical enrollment snapshots. Missing = assigned minus submitted; overdue = expired minus submitted expired tasks. Consistent = at least 80% assigned tasks submitted on time. Score is average quiz score; summary is weighted by quiz count. Private no-store. Pagination applies to participants; export follows all pages.

200.description: Paginated participant metrics with filtered summary and authorized filter options

post.summary: Withdraw survey results for Call Center review
post.description: Call Center or module admin only. Allowed from survey_submitted or review2 before an Approver decision. Preserves applicant, survey and documents; transitions to survey_cc_review. Repeated review and submission are supported. Version locking prevents withdrawing after a concurrent decision.

post.summary: Record an externally performed workflow step
post.description: Call Center, module admin or Superadmin only. Executes the existing stage transition and completeness/evidence/version checks without impersonating the field officer. No arbitrary status writes. manual identifies the real performer (active matching account or external name), channel, actual date and source note; recorder identity comes from authentication. Survey and handover performer must match assignment. Funding groups remain protected. External verifier becomes distributor automatically after amount approval. Phones and source notes are encrypted and shown only in authorized detail/history. Other roles cannot use this endpoint or bypass checks through the regular action endpoint.

200.description: Authorized application detail with persisted manual attribution

post.summary: Record external decision for a complete funding group
post.description: Call Center or module admin/Superadmin. Same decision, reason, group version and complete item versions as the normal decision endpoint plus manual attribution (actorId or name, channel, date, note). The entire group is updated atomically, existing state/version/amount checks apply, and every application audit preserves the real performer and authenticated recorder.

200.description: Funding group with synchronized application decisions

post.summary: Upload private application photo with optional location
post.description: Existing stage, role and sensitive-document permissions apply. Use multipart fields location[latitude], location[longitude], location[source] and optionally location[accuracy]. No location is inferred for old photos. clientId replay preserves the first upload and its location.

file.description: JPEG, PNG or WEBP; maximum 2048 KiB

location.description: Uploader-provided coordinates, not verified proof. exif = GPS from original metadata; device = device position at upload, not capture. Encrypted at rest. Legacy photos have null location.

201.description: Photo created; data contains id and kind

get.summary: Read authorized application details and private photo pins
get.description: Preserves existing record scope and sensitive-document filtering. Private no-store. Location is returned only for visible documents.

post.summary: Reset an operational account password without its old password
post.description: Active module admins may reset operational accounts only when every target module is managed by that admin. Superadmin may reset operational accounts across modules. Admin identities, superadmin, self and unassigned accounts are excluded. Writes only a password hash, revokes every target token and logs actor/target without credentials. No password is returned. Rate limit 10 requests/minute.

post.summary: Create audio or PDF material
post.description: Academy administrators only. Combined audio and PDF maximum 50 MiB. PDF-only material can be published. Omitted files preserve existing content. Database changes and stored files are rolled back on failure. Private attachments retain enrollment and release checks; no public file URL is created.

put.summary: Update material and optionally upload audio or PDF
put.description: Academy administrators only. Combined audio and PDF maximum 50 MiB. PDF-only material can be published. Omitted files preserve existing content. Database changes and stored files are rolled back on failure. Private attachments retain enrollment and release checks; no public file URL is created.

get.summary: Read the signed-in participant profile
get.description: Authenticated active account only. Always resolves participant by authenticated user; no userId/profileId input selects another account. Available before the initial password change. Returns own assigned cohort title only and Cache-Control: no-store, private. No password hash, token, other cohort metadata or other users are returned.

put.summary: Update own participant name, phone and address
put.description: Authenticated active participant after initial password change. Strict allowlist rejects every field except name, phone, address, including selectors, cohort, gender and account/participant codes. Own Core user name and Academy contact fields are saved atomically; password, identifiers and memberships are preserved. Indonesian phone prefixes 08/+628/628 and spaces/hyphens normalize to 628 digits. Returns updated own profile with no-store, private.

post.summary: Reopen the assigned verifier survey for correction
post.description: Only the assigned verifier, from survey_cc_review or survey_submitted before amount approval. Returns to survey_assigned, preserves survey data and evidence, and requires resubmission through Call Center review. Version locking prevents concurrent decisions.

post.summary: Submit one or multiple private audio/video files
post.description: Participant in the assigned task group, before deadline. 1–10 files, combined maximum 50 MiB. Every file is inspected and must match the task type. Legacy file field remains supported but cannot be combined with files. Atomically replaces the entire rejected attempt; pending/approved submissions reject duplicates. One review and attempt count per batch.

get.summary: Play a private submission attachment
get.description: Same owner/assigned teacher/module-admin authorization for every file; index defaults to zero for legacy players. Private no-store; storage paths are not exposed in files metadata.

post.summary: Submit one or multiple private audio/video files
post.description: Participant in the assigned task group, before deadline. 1–10 files, combined maximum 50 MiB. Every file is inspected and must match the task type. Legacy file field remains supported but cannot be combined with files. Atomically replaces the entire rejected attempt; pending/approved submissions reject duplicates. One review and attempt count per batch.

get.summary: Play a private submission attachment
get.description: Same owner/assigned teacher/module-admin authorization for every file; index defaults to zero for legacy players. Private no-store; storage paths are not exposed in files metadata.

x-core-account-access-policy.description: Core module access grants are only for module administrators (AMSIP or existing admin access), and entries must use role admin. Operational accounts retain their home-module roles; Core identity updates must omit entries. Attempts to change their access return 422. Superadmin access is automatic.

x-lazsip-campaign-target.description: Campaign target is optional. Missing on create, null and zero mean no target (stored and returned as zero). Missing on update preserves existing target. Donations remain available without a target.

observer.label: Pengurus
observer.scope: All applications and private details, documents, timeline and funding groups
observer.combinedRoles: Other explicitly granted roles retain their own mutation permissions

surveyApprover.label: Penyetuju Survei
surveyApprover.resolution: First valid versioned decision wins; existing Approver and Chair retain first stage access

x-bantuan-application-visibility.rule: Union of granted roles. Restricted-only accounts see applications they created or are assigned to as verifier/distributor. Any all-applications role sees all applications, including rows without an amount. The ongoing view intersects this scope with active statuses. Mutation permissions and private-document access remain separately authorized.

x-bantuan-application-notes.description: Optional per-application message from the applicant, supported for every intake source and drafts. Included in authorized application details; separate from survey notes and internal comments.

x-bantuan-permanent-deletion.description: May permanently delete applications at any stage, including applications created by another officer. Non-draft deletion requires exact application number confirmation; version locking remains mandatory. Other operational roles retain owned-draft deletion only.

x-bantuan-application-search.matching: Case-insensitive literal tokens; all tokens may match different supported fields. Pagination, menu filters, task assignment and row visibility remain in force.
x-bantuan-application-search.privateFields: Address, survey address, phone, job, problem and application notes only for rows the current officer can read sensitively. NIK only exact 16 digits. Encrypted private fields are streamed in the scoped server query, never stored as plaintext indexes or returned by search.

requiredContentFields.phone: string, 8-50 characters; optional leading +, digits, spaces, parentheses, dots and hyphens

x-lazsip-contact-validation.description: Invalid updates preserve the previously saved public contact details.

x-bantuan-photo-locations.visibility: Same document filtering and record ownership as private photos. No public location endpoint. Browser builds a map link only after authorization. Opening it shares coordinates with the map provider.

x-core-operational-password-reset.accountList: GET /api/v1/core/module-accounts: accounts[].canResetPassword is a UI hint only; authorization is repeated on mutation.
x-core-operational-password-reset.passwordVisibility: Only the new password entered in the browser can be copied after success. Existing passwords are never retrievable.

x-api-error-diagnostics.compatibility: Existing error.code/message/details remain. Diagnostic metadata is additive. Database duplicates/constraints and busy states return 409; unavailable connections return 503; schema mismatches and unknown database errors return 500.
x-api-error-diagnostics.privacy: No SQL, bindings, password, exception message, stack or configuration values in public diagnostics. api_request_failed logs include correlation ID, category, route template, exception class and source location, with SQLSTATE/driver code for database failures; request bodies, full URLs, SQL and bindings are not logged by this handler.

x-ipaymu-request-authentication.serialization: One JSON string with JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES and JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE (literal UTF-8); the same bytes are signed and sent as application/json.
x-ipaymu-request-authentication.signature: HMAC-SHA256 hexadecimal using ApiKey as key
x-ipaymu-request-authentication.credentials: Trim surrounding whitespace from VA/API key consistently; reject internal whitespace in API key. Snapshot the normalized VA on new transactions.
x-ipaymu-request-authentication.diagnostics: payment:ipaymu-check validates configuration; --remote calls /api/v2/balance and discards financial values. Never prints key, VA or signature. Checkout distinguishes IPAYMU_SIGNATURE_REJECTED from IP/domain rejection; definite HTTP 4xx rejections allow retrying the same pending transaction.

x-sip-content-galleries.behavior: Optional ordered public gallery. Omitted on update preserves existing photos; [] clears gallery. IDs must be distinct. Authenticated SIP content editors only can mutate. Draft news galleries remain private.

x-bantuan-survey-photo-replacement: DELETE documents permits assigned survey document corrections during survey_assigned and survey_cc_review, including previously used survey evidence. Uploader/Admin ownership and document-role authorization still apply. Files are retained for audit; deleted photos do not count toward requirements. Evidence is locked after forwarding to approval.

x-academy-material-pdfs.listing: Material listing _count.pdfs counts PDF attachments alongside existing _count.attachments. File links are disclosed only in authorized detail/admin contexts.
x-academy-material-pdfs.access: Existing private file endpoint and enrollment/release checks remain unchanged.

x-bantuan-verifier-intake-edit: Verifiers may correct applications they created during draft, needs_data, screening, review1, survey_assignment, survey_assigned and bypass_review. Existing source restrictions, authorization, completeness and optimistic locking apply. Other users and approved applications are not unlocked.
